Container.Name: SlateWatch
Container.Overview: SECURITY: Trusted-network use only. SlateWatch requires app-native administrator authentication and can trigger media-stack control actions. Basic credentials require HTTPS on untrusted networks. Never expose this port directly to the public internet. Restrict access with a trusted LAN, VPN, firewall allowlist, or authenticated reverse proxy. Self-hosted movie and TV tracking platform for watchlists, watched history, releases, and personal media tracking.

Config.Name: Admin Password
Config.Description: Required administrator password with at least 12 characters. Store it only in Unraid configuration and never publish it.
